preconditions.description: The height of the playing field is between 1 and 1000.
The width of the playing field is between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: Each line in the input contains exactly m characters.
preconditions.description: The field is represented by n lines, each with m characters.
The field is filled with '#' for initially filled cells and '.' for empty cells.

postconditions.expression: Output is '-1' if there is no way to fill the field.
postconditions.description: If the field cannot be filled according to the rules, output '-1'.

postconditions.expression: Output is a valid filling of the field with figures.
postconditions.description: If the field can be filled, output a valid filling with figures represented by digits.

postconditions.expression: Figures should be connected and entirely inside the board.
postconditions.description: Each figure should be connected by side and entirely within the bounds of the playing field.

postconditions.expression: Each initially empty cell should be filled with exactly one cell of some figure.
postconditions.description: Every initially empty cell must be filled with exactly one cell of some figure.

postconditions.expression: Figures should not touch each other by side.
postconditions.description: Figures should be represented by distinct digits and should not touch each other by side.
